properties.name: Orbital bus line (on the loop road)
Agusan River corridor (concept alignment, align to survey)
Butuan Central
properties.desc: City hall, courts, convention centre and the main transit interchange, rebuilt around a car-free civic plaza on the river. The one place where L1, L2 and L3 meet.

properties.name: Agusan Riverpark
properties.desc: A wide river corridor kept free of buildings, with terraces, ponds and cycle paths. It carries floods through the city instead of fighting them. Alignment is conceptual and must be fitted to the surveyed river.

properties.name: Balangay Heritage Quarter
properties.desc: Museum, archaeology park and boat-building workshops that keep the city's balangay story alive, with river walks to the centre.

properties.name: Bancasi Aerotropolis
properties.desc: The existing airport kept and extended, with air cargo, maintenance and an innovation band beside it. Rail-ready freight yard.

properties.name: Caraga Education & Research City
properties.desc: University campus, research institutes and student housing on the east line (L1).

properties.name: Medical City
properties.desc: Tertiary and teaching hospital, rehabilitation and elder care, close to the centre and on the river line (L2).

properties.name: Agri-Tech Innovation Park
properties.desc: Labs and pilot plants for rice, coconut and aquaculture technology, next to the farm belt it serves.

properties.name: Bay Waterfront Town
properties.desc: A walkable town facing the bay, with a mangrove boardwalk, fish landing and tourism. Raised, with the mangrove belt as its sea defence.

properties.name: East Town & Sports City
properties.desc: Stadium, aquatic centre and sports fields at the end of L1, ringed by mixed-use housing.

properties.name: South Agro-Industrial Town
properties.desc: Processing, cold storage and wholesale market that turn the farm belt's harvest into products. Waste heat and waste go to the circular park.

properties.name: Circular-Economy Park
properties.desc: Sorting and recycling, composting, biogas from organic waste and sludge, and treated wastewater for farms and parks. Sited away from homes.

properties.name: Solar Farm A
properties.desc: Ground-mounted solar with battery storage on non-prime land. The grid is a set of local microgrids that can island in a storm.

properties.name: Solar Farm B
properties.desc: Second solar and storage site, placed far from the first so one storm cannot take out both.

properties.name: Solar Farm C
properties.desc: Third solar and storage site in the north-east.

properties.name: Watershed Forest Reserve
properties.desc: Upland forest kept and restored to protect water supply, slow floods and hold carbon.

properties.name: Coastal Wetland & Mangrove Reserve
properties.desc: The bay shore left to mangrove and tidal marsh, the city's natural flood and storm-surge barrier.

meta.title: Butuan 2050 · Site Development Plan (concept)
meta.prompt: You are an expert urban planner, design/reimagine the city using the butuan-boundary.geojson, into a progressive, self sustaining and world-class city. Create a "Site Development Plan"-like map of the city
meta.source: City boundary: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL). Plan: generated by script, not surveyed.

legend.label: Central business & civic core
legend.desc: Mid- and high-rise offices, city hall, courts, convention centre. Ground floors open to the street, no surface parking.

legend.label: Mixed-use transit corridor
legend.desc: Homes above shops and services within a 5-minute walk of a station. Reduced parking, wide sidewalks.

legend.label: Residential, medium density
legend.desc: Walk-up and mid-rise housing around a neighbourhood hub. Mixed tenure, including social housing.

legend.label: Residential, low density
legend.desc: Detached and row houses with gardens on the edge of the urban area. Raised plinths, rainwater tanks.

legend.label: Neighbourhood hub (school, clinic, market)
legend.desc: One per 1 km square: elementary school, health centre, public market, evacuation shelter.

legend.label: University & medical campus
legend.desc: Research university, teaching hospital and student housing, linked to the east transit line.

legend.label: Innovation & light industry
legend.desc: Agri-tech labs, makers' workshops, clean manufacturing, data centre on the renewable grid.

legend.label: Agro-industrial & food hub
legend.desc: Rice, coconut and fruit processing, cold chain, wholesale market. Waste heat feeds the biogas plant.

legend.label: Airport & logistics
legend.desc: Existing airport kept and extended, air cargo, maintenance, and a rail-ready freight yard.

legend.label: Heritage & culture
legend.desc: Balangay heritage quarter: museum, archaeology park, boat-building workshops, riverside walks.

legend.label: Parks, greenways & sports
legend.desc: Shaded greenways, sports fields and playgrounds. Most homes are within a 5-minute walk of a park.

legend.label: Urban farms & community gardens
legend.desc: Neighbourhood farms and food forests that feed the local market.

legend.label: River corridor & retention wetlands
legend.desc: Floodway kept free of buildings, ponds and wetlands that hold storm water and cool the city.

legend.label: Solar farm & battery storage
legend.desc: Ground-mounted solar on land that is not prime farmland. Rooftop solar is required on every new roof.

legend.label: Circular-economy park
legend.desc: Materials recovery, composting, biogas from waste and sludge, wastewater reuse.

legend.label: Farm belt (food security)
legend.desc: Rice, corn and vegetables kept as farmland. A ring of food around the city.

legend.label: Watershed forest (protected)
legend.desc: Upland forest that protects the water supply and slows floods. Reforested, no new building.

legend.label: Coastal wetland & mangrove (protected)
legend.desc: Mangrove and tidal marsh on the bay. A natural flood and storm-surge barrier.

assumptions: Walk distances are straight lines from block centres, not routed paths.
Solar yield is assumed at 0.7 MWp per hectare.
Population is the capacity at assumed gross densities per hectare of block land (see legend), not a forecast.
Land-use classes outside the urban area are conceptual. Check them against terrain, flood and soil data before use.
